chunks: And Kulayb al-Asadī narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the nahr, and he said: “As for Minā, it is three days; and as for the towns, it is one day.”

key_terms.النَّحْرِ: the ritual sacrifice or slaughter being asked about
key_terms.الْبُلْدَانِ: the towns or other localities outside Minā
key_terms.بِمِنًى: in Minā, the location where the ruling lasts three days
key_terms.ثَلَاثَةُ أَيَّامٍ: three days, the duration of nahr in Minā
key_terms.فَيَوْمٌ وَاحِدٌ: one day, the duration of nahr outside Minā

ai.seo_question: How many days is the sacrifice valid in Minā and in other towns according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the days of nahr (sacrifice). It distinguishes between Minā, where the ruling extends to three days, and other towns, where it is limited to one day.
